issues.title: Magnitude and periodicity remain qualitative
issues.disposition: No numerical threshold, event period, weighting, or override test is supplied here; do not manufacture one.

issues.title: Country/city subdivision has a reported alternative
issues.disposition: Preserve adopted cities-only and reported both-countries-and-cities wording; neither alters the higher general/individual division.

issues.title: The opening inputs are not a complete selection algorithm
issues.disposition: Regional familiarities and proper-region examples require later chapters; house and term examples are not exhaustive or a new numerical score.

issues.title: Ecliptical-conjunction and rising terminology
issues.disposition: Preserve this passage's nouns. Detailed eclipse event classes and visibility rules are not settled by this introductory sentence.

issues.title: Source-relative geography is incompletely numerical
issues.disposition: The Bears and an inhabited northern quarter are not a supplied GIS map; no automatic modern country borders, latitude cutoffs or east/west origin are admitted.

issues.title: Historical ethnography is not modern population evidence
issues.disposition: The source asserts hierarchical group portraits and analogical causes. Archive them faithfully; do not erase, endorse or operationalize them as modern personal/ethnic character claims.

issues.title: Probable dependence is not established genealogy
issues.disposition: Robbins attributes probable Posidonius dependence and reports Boll; those cited works were not inspected here.

issues.title: Adopted sanguine wording does not supply a clinical variable
issues.disposition: Retain Robbins's lexical choice rather than replacing it with a modern temperament or medical classification.

issues.title: Nested eastern/western group and frankness readings
issues.disposition: Do not universalize the pronoun reference; retain Anonymous freedom-of-speech and felicitous-expression alternatives as alternatives.

issues.title: Local-modifier magnitudes are not given
issues.disposition: Terrain/proximity examples qualify the argument but furnish no coefficients, directions for every factor, or predictive calibration.

issues.title: Generally is not a numerical probability
issues.disposition: The explicit not-every-individual clause gives no prevalence, exception selection, or license to relabel any observed miss as support.
